title: Jesus Calls Matthew
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Matthew, also called Levi, was a tax collector. He took money from people for the rulers. Some tax collectors took extra, so people did not like them.
Jesus walked by and said, “Follow Me.” Matthew left everything and followed Him. Then he made a big feast, and many tax collectors came.
Some leaders grumbled, “Why does Jesus eat with those people?”
p2: Jesus said, “Healthy people do not need a doctor. Sick people do.” Jesus is like a kind doctor. He came to help hearts that need to change.
Jesus did not walk past Matthew. He welcomes everyone, including you. Tomorrow, invite someone who is left out to sit with you.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
